thread:
sylvia: Heads up — Harbor Health sent RFP v2.1. They want the full capability matrix, architecture attachments (onprem + VPC), and a POC schedule with pricing tiers. I can draft the written RFI answers but need ENG/SE input on HSM/KMS, Dedicated sizing, and POC billing. Who can own which pieces?

josh: I can own the architecture diagrams and the onprem packaging notes. Will pull the infra checklist together. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial drafts.

gabe: I'll take the capability matrix and the feature/constraints writeups (latency, throughput, streaming, embeddings). @matt can you confirm Dedicated capacity numbers and the burst policy so I can put costs in?

matt: Dedicated numbers: baseline POC config = 4xA100 per tenant (shared pools option available), with burst to 8x for short windows. Expected throughput numbers: ~400 tok/s gen on that profile; embeddings ~120 qps per GPU. Latency SLO we usually quote: 95th <120ms for 1k token requests (depends on model). KMS: we support customer-managed KMS for AWS/GCP (CMEK) and partner HSM for onprem; remote signing attestation timeline is longer. I'll add these into the matrix.

sylvia: Perfect. On pricing: Harbor asked about a POC discount and committed capacity pricing. Proposed POC terms: 30-day trial, then billed at 50% of reserved rate for first 3 months if they convert. Can we confirm that policy? Need solid numbers by Monday.

gabe: That policy sounds fine. I'll draft the numeric quote (per-GPU/hour, per-embedding unit) and include egress/data residency costs. Question: Harbor requires US-only data residency and wants to see SOC2 + FedRAMP mention — we can provide SOC2 report but we do not have FedRAMP. Flagging as a potential sales blocker.

sylvia: Flag noted. I'll call their security lead tomorrow to set expectations on FedRAMP. We'll offer SOC2 + audit logs + optional onprem.

josh: Uploading draft artifacts to the RFP folder: architecture-v2.png, rfi_answers_draft.docx. Snippet for the RFI: ```Network: VPC peering + private endpoints; KMS: CMEK via AWS/GCP, HSM via partner integration (onprem package). Deployment: Hosted, Dedicated, Private (VPC/onprem) supported.```

rfi-bot: Attachment uploaded to /rfp/harbor/ : rfi_answers_v0.9.docx, architecture-v2.png

matt: One technical caveat to add to the matrix: Harbor asked for onprem HSM attestation and remote signing support. Our onprem package supports HSM through certified partners, but attestation/cert collection timeline is ~6-8 weeks. If they need <2 weeks, we should propose using cloud KMS for the POC.

sylvia: Good call — I'll surface that as an operational constraint in the RFI answers. Also adding a question back to them re: required attestation level.

gabe: For the capability_matrix.xlsx I'll include columns: feature, supported (yes/no/partial), notes, POC_constraints, reference_attachment. Rows: model variants, streaming, function-calling, kv-caching, quantization support, embedding throughput, SLA targets, KMS/HSM notes. Will attach perf numbers.

sylvia: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Goal: final RFP package (answers + capability matrix + pricing + diagrams) by Mon 09:00 PT. I'll schedule a prep call for Fri 10:00 PT to run through the package.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled — "Harbor Health RFP prep" Fri 10:00 PT. Invitations sent to sylvia, josh, matt, gabe.

gabe: I'll have a draft matrix and pricing spreadsheet in the folder by Fri 08:00 PT so we can iterate before the call.

sylvia: Awesome — appreciate it. If anything blocks earlier, ping me in thread or DM.
